description: IRI is a repeatedly revised empirical reference for the ionosphere sponsored by COSPAR and URSI. For a specified place and time it supplies climatological electron density, temperatures and ion composition based on multiple observing systems. The resource is documented by NASA Community Coordinated Modeling Center (metadata publisher; developer not specified). The documented physical domain is Global Ionosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Instant Run, Runs-on-Request, Public Repository. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. Monthly-average reference conditions should not be mistaken for a forecast of a particular geomagnetic storm. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
